differing.baseline: From the controlled burning by indigenous peoples to prevent wildfires, to the Inuit methods of weather prediction, and the 'zaï' (<style id='1'>zaï</style>) water harvesting techniques used in some African countries, traditional indigenous practices around the world are diverse and effective, embodying the wisdom of indigenous peoples. In the context of climate change and the ongoing loss of biodiversity, this knowledge is particularly valuable.
